members.name: all
members.description:
When `true`, resolve every address for `hostname` instead of just the first. Defaults to
`false`.

members.name: family
members.description: Restrict resolution to `4` (IPv4) or `6` (IPv6), or `0` for either. Defaults to `0`.

members.name: keepAlive
members.description: Enable keep-alive on the socket once connected. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: keepAliveInitialDelay
members.description: The initial delay in milliseconds before the first keep-alive probe is sent. Defaults to `0`.

members.name: lookup
members.description: The function used to resolve hostnames. Defaults to `dns.lookup` from `bare-dns`.

members.name: noDelay
members.description: Send data immediately without buffering, disabling Nagle's algorithm. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: port
members.description: The port to connect to.

members.name: timeout
members.description: An inactivity timeout in milliseconds, set on the socket once connected.

members.name: addRequest
signatures: addRequest(req: HTTPClientRequest, opts: TCPSocketOptions & TCPSocketConnectOptions): void
members.description:
Assigns a socket to `req`, reusing an idle keep-alive socket for the same origin if one is
available, creating a new one if there is room, and queueing the request until one comes free
otherwise.

params.name: req
params.description: The request to assign a socket to.

params.name: opts
params.description: The socket and connection options, including the destination `host` and `port`.

members.name: defaultPort
members.description: The port used for a request that names none.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Destroys all sockets currently held by the agent, both in-use and free.

members.name: freeSockets
members.description: An iterator over the agent's idle, keep-alive sockets awaiting reuse.

members.name: getName
members.description:
Returns the pool key used to group sockets by destination, derived from `opts.host`,
`opts.port`, `opts.localAddress`, `opts.family`, and `opts.socketPath`.

params.name: opts
params.description: The connection options to derive the pool key from.

members.name: keepAlive
members.description: Whether the agent keeps sockets open for reuse once a request completes.

members.name: keepSocketAlive
members.description:
Marks `socket` to be kept alive and unreferenced instead of closed once a request completes.
Returns whether the socket was kept alive.

params.name: socket
params.description: The socket to keep alive for reuse.

members.name: maxFreeSockets
members.description: How many sockets the agent may keep in its pool for a single origin once they are free.

members.name: maxSockets
members.description: How many sockets the agent may hold at once for a single origin.

members.name: maxTotalSockets
members.description: How many sockets the agent may hold at once across every origin it talks to.

members.name: resume
members.description: Resumes an agent suspended with `suspend()`, allowing it to create connections again.

members.name: resumed
members.description:
A promise that resolves once a suspended agent is resumed, or `null` if the agent isn't
suspended.

members.name: reuseSocket
members.description: Marks `socket` as back in active use, referencing it so it keeps the event loop alive.

params.name: socket
params.description: The socket to mark as back in active use.

params.name: req
params.description: The request the socket is being reused for.

members.name: sockets
members.description: An iterator over all sockets currently held by the agent, both in-use and free.

members.name: suspend
members.description:
Suspends the agent, destroying all its sockets and preventing new connections until `resume()`
is called.

members.name: suspended
members.description: Whether the agent is currently suspended.

members.name: appendHeader
members.description:
Adds `value` to header `name` (case-insensitive), keeping any value already set rather than
replacing it, so that the field is sent once per value. `Cookie` is the exception, whose values
are folded onto a single line separated by `'; '`.

params.name: name
params.description:
The header name (case-insensitive); must be a valid RFC 9110 token, and must not
be `__proto__`.

params.name: value
params.description:
The header value; must not contain a control character other than tab. Every
element of an array value is checked in turn, and `null` is allowed.

throws.condition: the headers have already been sent.
`name` is not a valid RFC 9110 token, or is `__proto__`.

`value` is `undefined`, or contains a control character other
than tab.

Sends the headers immediately, if they haven't already been sent, instead of waiting for the

params.name: name

members.name: headers

The headers to send with the request, keyed by lowercase name, including an auto-generated

members.name: headersSent

members.name: method

members.name: path

members.name: setHeader
members.description:
Sets header `name` (case-insensitive) to `value`, replacing any value already set and
validating both.

params.name: name
params.description:
The header name (case-insensitive); must be a valid RFC 9110 token, and must not

params.name: value
